title: "[FEATURE] "

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🎯 Use Case

Why do you need this feature? What problem would it solve?

## 📝 Proposed Solution

How should this feature work? Include:
- What inputs/options would be added?
- What actions/behavior should change?
- Any example configurations?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Are there workarounds you've tried? Why don't they meet your needs?

## ➕ Additional Context

Any other details, mockups, or examples?
